name: pw-locator-inspector
description: Embedded VS Code browser and live Playwright locator highlighting from code (Page Objects, helpers, and tests)
author: Rudoi S.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Playwright Locator Inspector executes Playwright from workspace node_modules and reads local project files, so it requires a trusted workspace.

editor/title.when: editorLangId == typescript || editorLangId == javascript || editorLangId == typescriptreact || editorLangId == javascriptreact

editor/context.when: editorLangId == typescript || editorLangId == javascript || editorLangId == typescriptreact || editorLangId == javascriptreact

pwLocatorInspector.viewportWidth.description: Default viewport width of the embedded browser

pwLocatorInspector.viewportHeight.description: Default viewport height of the embedded browser

pwLocatorInspector.storageStatePath.description: Relative or absolute path to a Playwright storageState (.json) file for authenticated sessions

pwLocatorInspector.readEnvFiles.description: Allow reading non-sensitive URL/config variables (e.g. BASE_URL, QA_URL) from workspace .env files. Sensitive keys (tokens, passwords, secrets, auth, keys) are always excluded.
